observed_counts.note: Do not add heterogeneous row counts or compute a total completion percentage.

defect_policy_changes.all_other_defects: Retain original IDs and evidence. Do not reset or promote their verdicts from this plan.

next_action.action: Verify baseline and current APK bytes, compare in the same available Android environment; isolate render/code/OS failures; check native Windows/save/signing/free sync prerequisites.
next_action.on_environment_block: Record per-platform evidence and required environment, stop unchanged retries, continue independent B2 source/contracts work.
next_action.do_not_repeat: Full P0/P1/P2 inventory, unchanged parsers, SDK setup, old long natural journeys with identical fingerprints.
next_action.resume_from: Latest active branch HEAD and this next_action, not the old planning branch.

retry_policy.research: After two distinct unsuccessful methods for the same gap group, use the next source tier; keep future new-evidence candidates.

gates.content: G1 required IDs bound and functional with normal acquisition/use paths
gates.platform_delivery: Native visible UI, normal input/play/save/restart for that exact artifact; NOT_RUN is not PASS
gates.replacement_update: Verified signing/package/save migration and rollback evidence
gates.full_goal: All contracted platform and sequential-account requirements actually verified; otherwise scope-qualified PARTIAL

historical.authority: Historical STEP/WORK_ORDER/RESULTS/STATE_* are evidence of their past tasks, not current restrictions.

publication.method: Atomic documentation/model commit on existing active Work branch, expected-HEAD lease, no force push
publication.verification: Re-query containing commit and active branch before handoff. Never reset to this baseline.
